result.summary: The page is largely functional and visually consistent, with intentional horizontally scrolling carousels. The main findings are minor content clipping/truncation at the right viewport edge and small accessibility/styling improvements; nothing appears critically broken.

issues.description: Restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is clipped mid-word as 'Trattoria Piccol' at the screen edge without a clear ellipsis, making the full name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Ensure truncated labels use an ellipsis within the card bounds or reduce card width/font so the text truncates cleanly before the viewport edge.

issues.description: The rightmost category chip after 'Healthy' is only partially visible and cut off abruptly at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: If the chip row is scrollable, add a fade/edge indicator or consistent end padding; otherwise fit chips within the viewport or wrap to a second row.

issues.description: The favorite heart icons are placed over busy food imagery with only a dark circular backdrop, which may be hard to see for some users and lacks a visible selected state distinction in the static view.
issues.suggestion: Increase the contrast/opacity of the icon backdrop and ensure the control has a clear focus/active state plus an accessible label.

issues.description: Promo banner text 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' mixes the code with conditions in one line, making the code slightly less scannable.
issues.suggestion: Visually emphasize the promo code (e.g., monospace chip or bolder treatment) and separate the minimum-order condition for quicker scanning.
